name: Germany
duration_software_special: software protected as computer program if original
rights_note: Five rights are collapsed from UrhG exploitation rights; communication includes public performance and making available.

name: United Kingdom
duration_literary_special: calculated from end of calendar year
duration_software_special: computer programs treated as literary works
rights_note: Communication includes performance, showing, playing, and communication to the public; translation is folded into adaptation.

name: United States
duration_literary_special: works made for hire may use publication/creation term
duration_software_special: software protected as literary work; works made for hire may differ
rights_note: Rental is not modeled as a general exclusive right; derivative works are folded into translation/adaptation.

name: France
duration_literary_special: war-related and other special terms may apply
duration_software_special: software has specific exploitation provisions but same general duration
rights_note: French representation and reproduction rights are mapped into the five canonical prototype rights.

name: Italy
duration_software_special: software protected as intellectual work if original
rights_note: Italian economic-use rights are collapsed into reproduction, distribution, communication, rental, and translation/adaptation.

name: Switzerland
rights_note: Swiss use rights are mapped to the five canonical prototype rights; rental mainly concerns software in the simplified model.

name: European Union
duration_software_special: software follows EU copyright framework subject to member-state implementation
rights_note: EU row represents harmonized directive-level concepts, not a single national copyright statute.

name: Canada
duration_literary_special: term runs after end of calendar year
duration_software_special: software generally protected as literary work
rights_note: Canadian copyright rights are collapsed into the five prototype exploitation-right columns.

name: New Zealand
duration_literary_special: calculated from end of calendar year
duration_software_special: computer programs protected as literary works
rights_note: New Zealand restricted acts are mapped into the five canonical prototype rights.
